# Show Webpage

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Shows a webpage at the given URLS.

## Syntax

~~~~text
showWebPage(url: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, reader: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
showWebPage(url: "https://jellycuts.com", reader: false)
~~~~
